sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for petitioner, learned State Counsel for opposite party No.1 and Mr. Mohd.
Yasir Abbasi learned counsel for opposite party No.2 whose power is taken on record.
In view of order being passed, notices to opposite parties 3 and 4 stand dispensed with.

Petition under Article 227 of Constitution of India has been filed seeking a direction to the court concerned for expeditious disposal of of execution case No. 141 of 2021 for compliance of order dated 8th June, 2022 passed in proceedings regarding enhancement of compensation of acquired property.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for petitioner submits that in the said proceedings, the respondents therein have already put in appearance and have filed their objections but only general dates are being allocated due to which expedite orders are required to be passed.

It is submitted that although the application under Section 34 of the Act has already been preferred but there is no interim order as yet due to which there is no impediment in expeditious disposal of execution case.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of opposite party No.2 submits that along with application under Section 34 an application for stay under Section 36(2) of the Act has also been preferred but he does not have current instructions as to whether any interim stay has been granted or not.

Considering submissions advanced by learned counsel for parties, the concerned court is directed to decide the execution case No. 141 of 2021 expeditiously without granting any undue adjournment to either parties in case there is no other legal impediment .
Benefit of this order shall be available to the petitioner only in case he cooperates with the proceedings.
With the aforesaid directions, the petition stands disposed of.
